caption: The drawing depicts a wooden figurine standing upright on a rectangular wooden base. The figure is colored with various shades including brown for the body, black for the hair, and beige for the legs. The figure is dressed in a dark purplish or brown tunic reaching to the knees, decorated with a light-colored border at the hem and gold shoulder accents. The figure’s upper body is adorned with a large, light, star-shaped medallion on its chest and a lengthwise gold trim on the sleeves and collar. The head has long dark hair, a headband, and a tall, upright headdress featuring gray and red vertical sections. The face shows a dark brown complexion, and the figure wears large round earrings. The right hand is gripping a cylindrical object in front, while the left hand is resting at the side. The legs are exposed below the tunic and are attached to a green bracket, fixed to the base for support. The drawing has a plain, light beige background with no other objects present.
